author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration; book is lighter fantasy but art should feel grounded and lifelike; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for the time being, and more if the style fits the series. For the map, wants something detailed and immersive with a classic fantasy-map feel, stylistically open. Contact: reply or DM on Threads @veliraiyawrites. Thread still receiving artist replies; no close notice.
